summary: SQL text (incl. N/q-alternative quoting), integer/number with e/f/d suffixes, DATE/TIMESTAMP literals, INTERVAL YEAR TO MONTH and DAY TO SECOND. PL/SQL defers here for non-BOOLEAN literals.
sketch: string ::= [N] ('…' | q'delim…delim'); number ::= [+-] digits/fraction [e exponent] [f|d]; interval ::= INTERVAL str qualifier.
notes: Q delimiter is any non-whitespace character with paired brackets for []{}()<> . Arbitrary delimiter forces L13/D9 scanner decision. Inventory: docs/spec/research/01-lexical-units-inventory.md.
